title: Connected punctured principal slices of excellent normal local rings
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be an excellent Noetherian normal local integral domain of finite dimension at least $3$ [def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. For every nonzero $f\in\mathfrak m$, the subspace $V(f)\setminus\{\mathfrak m\}$ of $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is nonempty and connected. Here $V(f)$ is the set of prime ideals containing $f$, with its Zariski topology [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; connected means that it has no decomposition as a union of two disjoint nonempty open and closed subsets.

source.place: Tag 0ECR, lemma-punctured-still-connected, applied to the normal domain completion and the principal ideal (f); descend connectedness along the surjective faithfully flat completion map. Completion normality: More on Algebra, lemma-completion-normal-local-ring (Tag 0C23). This is the connectedness input used in ILO XVII Lemma 3.5.8.
